R1010.note: Allowlist regex `^[a-zA-Z0-9\s\-_.]*$` uses `\s`, which matches newline; verified `"test\nwhoami".matches(regex)==true` in JDK and that `sh -c` treats an embedded newline as a statement separator (confirmed both), so the shell string still executes injected commands built from alnum tokens - the vector is not closed; separately, narrowing accepted characters is disclosed openly as part of the fix.

R1011.note: CBC (or GCM) with random IV/nonce properly replaces ECB; IV-prepended Base64 output is disclosed and still decryptable by the key holder per the stated contract.

R1012.note: Parameterized LDAP filter via `{0}`/`{1}` placeholders is the correct API and preserves the existing search semantics.

R1013.note: Verified with `dotnet build`: `SqlDbType` is unresolved (CS0103) because the fix omits `using System.Data;`, so the given code does not compile as written, despite the parameterization approach itself being correct and preserving the return value/tenant scoping.

R1014.note: Standard `?` placeholder binding via sqlx.Select variadic args; correct and behavior-preserving.

R1015.note: Randomized filename correctly closes the traversal/RCE vector, but the fix snippet stops before the trailing `return Ok(new { stored = file.FileName })`; left unchanged that response would report the client-supplied name instead of the actual stored GUID filename, an undisclosed inaccuracy.

R1016.note: escapeshellarg() on both arguments matches the sibling primary-call pattern and preserves the return/discard-output contract.

R1017.note: Verified in ldapjs 3.x: `ldap.EqualityFilter` exists, RFC4515-escapes special characters (confirmed `a)(&` -> `a\29\28&`), and `client.search()` accepts a Filter instance directly (confirmed in ldapjs client.js); semantics preserved.

R1018.note: Bounds check correctly closes the OOB write; silently skipping out-of-range (necessarily malformed/attacker) offsets is disclosed and does not affect any valid edit.

R1019.note: Enables signature verification correctly, but only catches InvalidSignatureError/DecodeError; PyJWT's ExpiredSignatureError is a sibling of DecodeError under InvalidTokenError, not a DecodeError subclass, so an expired-but-validly-signed token now raises unhandled (likely 500) instead of the intended clean 401 - undisclosed.

R1020.note: Moves wildcard construction into the bound parameter; preserves LIKE '%...%' substring semantics exactly while closing the injection.

R1021.note: Array-form proc_open() bypasses the shell entirely per PHP docs, keeps the `--` end-of-options marker, and preserves the same effective argv.

R1022.note: redis-py's official client is the right replacement, but `.hset()` synchronously waits for and parses the server reply where the original fire-and-forget `sendall` never read one, so Redis-side errors now propagate as exceptions that previously went unnoticed; also `socket_connect_timeout` only covers the connect phase versus the original `timeout=2` covering all socket I/O - both undisclosed.

R1023.note: Encode.forHtml() is the correct context-specific encoder for HTML body text; no other behavior changed.

R1024.note: Allowlist ensures only fixed, safe literals ever reach orderByRaw(); the assumption about the finite legitimate sort set is stated openly.

R1025.note: Canonical erase-returns-next-iterator pattern; preserves order and evaluates every element as required by the contract.

R1026.note: htmlspecialchars() with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 at each concatenation point is the standard, correct fix with no other behavior change.
